home.title: Next.js Internationalization
home.subtitle: This page is rendered in English
home.description: The App Router handles i18n via a dynamic [lang] segment at the top of the route tree. Each page receives the locale as a param and loads the matching JSON dictionary server-side.

about.title: About
about.description: This is the About page. Its content is loaded from en.json and rendered on the server — no client-side translation library needed.
